release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Optimizes routine M3U-removal checks with a complete source-only census: streamed account/provider IDs and direct show membership keys, without title cleaning, identity serialization, metadata table writes or lookup-index builds. Initial discovery and Rebuild / discover inventory retain full metadata. Rechecks after provider episode refresh use sources only. Skips the census entirely when M3U checks are not due and no roots need discovery. Preserves category/batch-independent completeness, stable source keys, account-specific orphan-show handling, failure guards, ownership/NFO protection, schema-2 discovery markers, standard-library portability and timing telemetry. Failed forced root checks invalidate discovery markers. Live-data parity verified all 627,666 source identities match the full census, with three Django queries each; source census reduced from about 17 to 8.2 seconds and preview to 10.4 seconds with zero errors/warnings. Validation: 312 local tests passed with four Windows platform skips; publisher/package/import checks passed.
